name: emergence
source:
Have you ever thought that an ordinary day could turn into a nightmare? While everything seems fine at the office, the obsession of a security guard turns your life upside down. You find yourself in what appears to be a regular pop-up betting site advertisement at first glance, but it’s actually a live stream belonging to the security guard. Now you're a prisoner, and you must fight to survive.

As you make escape plans, you must tread carefully with every step, as one wrong move could ruin everything. A variety of different endings await you—some may seem like salvation, but they’re not quite what they appear... and some are even worse...
[From [url=https://vinly87.itch.io/emergence]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你有没有想过，平凡的一天会变成一场噩梦？虽然办公室里一切看起来都很好，但保安的痴迷却让你的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。乍一看，你发现自己身处一个普通的弹出式投注网站广告中，但实际上这是保安人员的直播。现在你是一名囚犯，你必须为生存而战。

当你制定逃跑计划时，每一步都必须小心谨慎，因为一个错误的举动可能会毁掉一切。各种不同的结局等待着你——有些可能看起来像是救赎，但事实并非如此……有些甚至更糟……
[来自[url=https://vinly87.itch.io/emergence]Itch.io[/url]]
